author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/02_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Laboratory Hazards Scenario/src.py

points.K1: 进入新实验室的第一天
points.K4: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一间实验室门口，手搭凉棚张望
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a laboratory doorway, shading its eyes with one paw and looking around curiously.
shots.narration: 这一课是个情景题：危害在哪？
overlay: 新实验室的危害在哪里

shots.scene: 欣欣手里举着一个大问号牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a big question mark sign and tilts its head.
shots.narration: 看完故事，请你一起来想答案。

shots.section_title: 进入新实验室的第一天
shots.scene: 阿杰背着书包，第一次走进一间明亮的实验室
shots.prompt_en: The young male student with a backpack walks into a bright laboratory for the first time, looking around.
shots.narration: 想象一下：今天是你进新实验室的第一天。
overlay: 进入新实验室的第一天

shots.section_title: 进入新实验室的第一天
shots.scene: 白色实验台、上层试剂架、离心机和几台小仪器
shots.prompt_en: A bright general laboratory: white benches, upper shelves of reagent bottles with blank labels, a centrifuge and several small instruments. No people.
shots.narration: 白色台面，满架试剂，还有好几台仪器。

shots.section_title: 进入新实验室的第一天
shots.scene: 阿杰望着满架的瓶子，眼睛发直
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stares at the shelves of bottles, looking a little overwhelmed.
shots.narration: 一切都很新，也很陌生。

shots.section_title: 进入新实验室的第一天
shots.scene: 阿杰把书包放在门边的柜子上，深吸一口气
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts his backpack on a cabinet by the door and takes a deep breath.
shots.narration: 这里会有哪些危险呢？

shots.scene: 老周走过来，和阿杰握手
shots.prompt_en: The older man walks over and shakes hands with the young male student.
shots.narration: 你的导师走过来，带你四处看看。

shots.scene: 老周带阿杰沿实验台走，指着上层试剂架
shots.prompt_en: The older man walks the young male student along the bench and points at the upper reagent shelves.
shots.narration: 他一边走，一边指出潜在的危害。

shots.scene: 老周指着离心机，阿杰认真点头
shots.prompt_en: The older man points at the centrifuge on the bench; the young male student nods seriously.
shots.narration: 这台仪器要注意，那排试剂要当心。

shots.scene: 老周指着台上的小仪器，阿杰在本子上记
shots.prompt_en: The older man points at small instruments on the bench while the young male student takes notes in a blank notebook.
shots.narration: 阿杰赶紧一条条记下来。

shots.scene: 老周看看手表，向阿杰挥手离开
shots.prompt_en: The older man checks his watch, waves to the young male student and walks away.
shots.narration: 可导师很忙，不会一直在你身边。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在实验室中间，头顶浮现大问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands in the middle of the laboratory with a big question mark floating above his head.
shots.narration: 问题来了：除了问导师，

shots.scene: 实验室全景，一个个小问号浮在各处
shots.prompt_en: A wide view of the laboratory with small question marks floating over the shelves, benches and instruments. No people.
shots.narration: 你怎么知道实验室里有哪些危害？

shots.scene: 欣欣对着镜头，竖起一根手指放在嘴边
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot faces the camera and puts one finger to its lips, as if asking for quiet thinking.
shots.narration: 先别急着往下看，停下来想一想。

shots.scene: 画面渐暗，只留一个沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: The screen slowly dims, leaving only an hourglass icon with falling sand in the center. No people.
shots.narration: 给自己一点时间，好好想想。

shots.scene: 阿杰在本子上写写画画，若有所思
shots.prompt_en: The young male student writes in a blank notebook, thinking hard.
shots.narration: 把你想到的途径，一条条列出来。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰一起挠头思考
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student both scratch their heads, deep in thought.
shots.narration: 想到的越多，第一天就越安心。

shots.section_title: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 一张空白课程卡片和一本更大的空白规程手册
shots.prompt_en: A small blank course card next to a larger blank procedure binder with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 本课面向实验室人员，
overlay: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.section_title: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 规程手册放大，旁边一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the blank procedure binder with a large green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 不能代替你实验室自己的规程。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现门和新手图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a laboratory door and a beginner badge.
shots.narration: 新进实验室，第一天就要认识危害。

shots.scene: 导师图标指向试剂架和仪器图标
shots.prompt_en: A supervisor icon pointing at icons of a reagent shelf and a centrifuge. No people.
shots.narration: 导师会带你看，指出潜在危害。

shots.scene: 一个大问号图标
shots.prompt_en: A large question mark icon glowing in the center. No people.
shots.narration: 除了问导师，还能靠什么？

shots.scene: 欣欣对镜头眨眨眼
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot winks at the camera with a friendly smile.
shots.narration: 这道题，留给你自己找答案。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰站在实验室门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student wave goodbye at the laboratory door.
shots.narration: 带着问题进实验室，下次见！
